name: highlight
summary: Show the player where things are, through walls and terrain, on their screen only: things, a network, or far points, tinted and labelled for a while. Nothing in the world changes.

help.text: targets, up to 64, each exactly one of reference_id, reference_ids (up to 1024 things), network_id (every piece of a cable, pipe or chute network, up to 4096) or at (a far point), with color, label and pulse. seconds default 60, max 600; a new call clears the last unless keep; clear only removes. Needs the player's view; distances are from its camera.

drawing.summary: How things and points are drawn.
drawing.text: Things are drawn with their own meshes as the game holds them (every part of a device, a frame at its build state), tinted, with the T-Ray SPU's see-through material, or a built-in one with the depth test off. A label stands at the thing nearest the camera. A point gets a tall beam, wider with distance, and a label with its distance, bearing (degrees clockwise from north, +z; 90 is east, +x) and height difference; out of view, the label and a >> arrow sit at the screen's edge toward it.

reply.text: targets [{index, kind (things, network, point), color, label, pulse, network_id, things (drawn), missing (ids naming nothing), truncated, at, distance_m, bearing_deg, compass, rise_m}], cleared, seconds, renderer (t-ray, built-in, or remote when the player's own game draws), notes, drawn_on (the player whose game drew them) and view {source, age_s}.

refusals.text: no_view and view_stale: no player view (see player/view). network_not_found and no_network: the network target names nothing. no_line_shader and no_xray_material: this game build lacks what drawing needs.

reference_ids.description: Several things in one colour, up to 1024.

network_id.description: A network, or any piece on it: every piece (see networks).

at.description: A far point, [x, y, z] in metres (see positions).

color.description: cyan, magenta, yellow, green, orange, blue, red, white, or [r, g, b] 0 to 1; default the next in turn.

label.description: Text shown at the target, up to 80 characters.

pulse.description: true: the tint swells once a second. Default false.

targets.description: What to show, up to 64; each exactly one of reference_id, reference_ids, network_id or at.

seconds.description: How long to show; default 60, max 600.

keep.description: true: keep what earlier calls drew. Default false.

clear.description: Only remove what is drawn; give nothing else.
